name: legwork
description: Lets your AI find the open-source tool it needs on GitHub and install it as an MCP tool, in a sandbox, after you approve.
long_description: When you ask for something Claude has no tool for (transcribe a voice memo, pull tables out of a PDF, remove an image background), it searches GitHub, picks a repo and asks you to approve installing it. Legwork scans the source for hidden payloads, builds a working tool in a sandbox (sandbox-exec on macOS, bubblewrap on Linux) and tests it. Installed tools read only the folders you choose here, read-only; get none of your environment variables or keys; and have no network unless you allow it. 37 common tools are cached and install with no API key; other repos need a model key in ~/.legwork.env (see the README).

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Search GitHub and the Legwork cache for a tool that does a job. Installs nothing.

tools.name: install_tool
tools.description: Install a GitHub repo as a sandboxed tool, after you approve.

tools.name: install_status
tools.description: Check on an install that is still building.

tools.name: list_installed_tools
tools.description: List installed tools, what each may read and the commit it was built from.

tools.name: use_tool
tools.description: Call a tool of an installed repo, in its sandbox.

folders.title: Folders tools may read
folders.description: The most any installed tool may read, read-only. Each install asks for these or fewer. Leave empty to give tools none of your files.

allow_net.title: Let tools use the internet
allow_net.description: Off: installed tools have no network while they run (installs can always download packages). On: a tool can use the internet if its install asks for it.
